title: HazardAuditor: From Executable Threats to Safer Computer-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.15134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents increasingly interact with browsers, terminals, file systems, and external services, introducing safety risks that emerge through runtime behavior rather than generated content alone. Existing guard models target static prompts and responses and are poorly suited to agent execution; existing executable safety platforms produce evaluation verdicts rather than the normalized supervision a guard model needs to learn across heterogeneous agent frameworks. We introduce HazardAuditor, an execution-grounded framework that closes both gaps. Its infrastructure runs heterogeneous agents (Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, and OpenClaw) in controlled environments and normalizes their interactions into a canonical event representation for cross-framework supervision. We further observe that token-level post-training objectives create a structural mismatch for generative guards, causing longer rationales to dominate gradient updates. Gua

translated_title: HazardAuditor：从可执行威胁到更安全的计算机使用智能体
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体日益与浏览器、终端、文件系统和外部服务进行交互，由此产生的安全风险主要体现在运行时行为上，而不仅仅是生成的内容。现有的防护模型针对静态提示和响应设计，难以适应智能体的执行过程；而现有的可执行安全平台只能产生评估判定，无法提供防护模型在异构智能体框架中学习所需的规范化监督数据。我们提出了HazardAuditor，一个基于执行过程的框架，能够同时弥补上述两个不足。其基础设施在受控环境中运行异构智能体（Claude Code、Codex、Hermes和OpenClaw），并将它们的交互规范化为标准事件表示，以实现跨框架的监督学习。我们进一步观察到，token级的后训练目标对生成式防护模型造成了结构性不匹配，导致较长的推理文本主导了梯度更新。
tldr: HazardAuditor是一个基于执行过程的安全框架，通过在受控环境中运行异构计算机使用智能体并将其交互规范化为标准事件表示，解决了现有防护模型无法监控智能体运行时行为、现有安全平台无法提供跨框架监督数据的问题。
en_tdlr: HazardAuditor is an execution-grounded framework that runs heterogeneous computer-use agents in controlled environments and normalizes their interactions into canonical event representations, addressing the gaps of guard models unable to monitor agent runtime behavior and existing safety platforms unable to provide cross-framework supervision data.
